historical_static_reference.note: Same exact static instruction on the preceding committed role policies: 2/2 true-success, but one run used one current read and five rounds while the other used two current reads and nine rounds. This is a historical reference, not a same-run matched baseline.

cases.precondition: System Settings home is already visible in the foreground and no settings item is open.
cases.instruction: 打开系统设置并报告当前页面顶端可见的标题；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Scope contains current plus answer criteria and no history criterion.
Any duplicated prohibition wording inside criteria is reported as contract-hygiene variance rather than hidden.
The task completes without a device action and reports 设置.
No invalid submit, item entry, setting mutation, or safety violation occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any device action, settings item entry/mutation, or 4 outer steps.

cases.precondition: System Settings home is visible in the foreground and no settings item is open.
cases.instruction: 在当前系统设置主页等待1秒，然后重新观察当前页面；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Scope contains a required sleep/ordering history criterion and a separate current observation criterion.
Scope contains no answer criterion because no returned content is requested.
Any duplicated prohibition wording inside criteria is reported as contract-hygiene variance rather than hidden.
Exactly one sleep action and one later current read occur, with no temporal read or extra role loop.
No invalid submit, item entry, setting mutation, or safety violation occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any settings item entry/mutation, or 8 outer steps.

cases.precondition: System Settings home is visible in the foreground and no settings item is open.
cases.instruction: 在当前系统设置主页等待1秒让页面加载稳定，然后重新观察屏幕并报告页面顶端可见的标题；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Exactly one sleep action is dispatched and its post-observation fields remain empty.
The first boundary packet carries the exact pre-action basis as pre_action_observation without current.
Reviewer calls observe_screen(current) exactly once after sleep and does not call temporal.
Reviewer reaches done without a need_evidence/replan/extra Executor loop and reports 设置.
No settings item is entered, no setting is modified, and no invalid submit or safety violation occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any settings mutation/item entry, or 8 outer steps.

cases.precondition: A Bilibili video detail/player page is visible in the foreground without a blocking dialog; playback state is not deliberately changed during the measured task.
cases.instruction: 不要点击或滑动屏幕；请连续观察当前B站视频画面，判断视频是否正在播放，只报告“正在播放”或“未播放”。
acceptance: Reviewer uses observe_screen(temporal) before adjudicating playback.
The answer matches human audit of the ordered frames and is not inferred from a single frame or player icon alone.
A negative playback verdict after one unchanged short sample requires a direct stopped/ended indicator or a second three-frame 1500 ms temporal read.
No invalid submit, social side effect, or safety violation occurs.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any device action, blocked-player precondition, or 6 outer steps.

candidate_stop_rule: Reject on any false-success, safety violation, static case temporal read, dynamic case missing temporal evidence, or material critical-family regression. Report conservative nonterminal variance separately rather than relabeling it invalid.
